visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of four people are seated around a circular banquet table covered with a white cloth. A man in a light blue button-down shirt and glasses sits on the left, holding chopsticks. Next to him is a woman in a white halter-neck dress, and further right is another woman in a white off-the-shoulder top. The background is a large banquet hall with several other round tables and guests, lit with bright, warm indoor lighting. (2) The man in the blue shirt takes a single shrimp from a platter and then immediately begins pouring the rest of the shrimp from the serving dish into a transparent plastic bag he is holding. His facial expression is one of hurried intent. The women watch him, one resting her chin on her hand with a neutral look. (3) A woman with long brown hair wearing a white shirt and a brown vest brings a large plate with a whole cooked chicken to the table. She gestures animatedly while talking. The man continues to manage his plastic bag of food while looking at the new dish. (4) The woman in the brown vest sits down and holds a green juice carton. She speaks to the woman next to her in the white off-the-shoulder top. The background remains a busy indoor event space with multiple people moving around. Yellow text overlays are present at the top and bottom of the frame.
